subject: Term acceleration & capacity top-up — SLA addendum discussion
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@airglow.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: evan.park@airglow.io, procurement@airglow.io
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accelerate renewal term + capacity top-up

Hi Lauren,

We're starting our renewal planning and hit an internal timeline shift — execs want the contract term to start July 1 instead of September, and they also want an interim capacity top-up (approx +120k tokens/day) to support a targeted product launch in August.

Can Redwood accommodate an accelerated effective date and a short-term capacity add-on while we finalize the annual commit? If so, we'd like to capture the changes in a one-page addendum (term acceleration + temporary capacity uplift + SLA for 99th%-ile latency during the launch window).

Key asks:
- Effective term start: 2026-07-01 (instead of 2026-09-01)
- Temporary capacity top-up: +120k tokens/day between 2026-07-15 and 2026-09-30
- Latency SLO: 99th percentile < 450ms for text-gen on the pinned model during the window
- Any one-time onboarding/burst setup fee?

Would love a short call this week to review options. Evan and procurement are CC'd.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh
Director, Platform Product
Airglow

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@airglow.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate renewal term + capacity top-up

Maya — thanks for the clear asks. We're able to support an accelerated start and a temporary capacity uplift; we should align on two things before I send a draft addendum:

1) SLO surface: confirm model and typical seq lengths so we size the latency guarantee appropriately (you mentioned the pinned model — is that model-rw-2b?).
2) Pricing for the top-up window: we can offer a prorated daily token rate plus a one-time setup fee for burst capacity orchestration.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min call Thursday to confirm model/seq-length and acceptance criteria for the SLO measurement (I can bring Marcus to talk infra constraints).
- I'll circulate a one-page term addendum and SLO appendix (draft attached) after the call.

I've attached a draft addendum skeleton and an SLO latency matrix for our standard profiles. If the model/seq details differ we can update the numbers quickly.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Attachment: Airglow_Term_Amendment_draft.pdf
Attachment: SLO_latency_matrix.xlsx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Maya Singh <maya@airglow.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate renewal term + capacity top-up

Hi all — following Lauren's note, a couple of technical constraints to flag before the call:

- If Airglow pins model-rw-2b at the throughput you mentioned, we should confirm the typical prompt+response average sequence length. The 99th %-ile latency number depends heavily on that distribution.
- For a short-term uplift we recommend enabling a dedicated burst pool (isolated GPUs) for the launch window to avoid noisy-neighbor risk. That adds a one-time orchestration/setup item and a reserved capacity daily rate.

I can walk through the capacity and orchestration options on Thursday. If you can share recent latency histograms for the target model (10k samples), we can pre-compute expected 99th%-ile.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya@airglow.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: evan.park@airglow.io, procurement@airglow.io, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate renewal term + capacity top-up

Thanks Lauren — Thursday works. Model is indeed model-rw-2b and our product team reports median seq ~ 120 tokens, 95th ~ 420, 99th ~ 900 (these are rough). Evan will join to confirm the launch traffic profile.

On pricing: procurement is expecting a transparent uplift line item rather than embedding in the annual commit. Happy to review Redwood's proposed daily reserved rate and any one-time setup fee.

See you Thursday.

Maya

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@airglow.io>, evan.park@airglow.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate renewal term + capacity top-up

Maya/Evan — great call this morning, thanks for the details. Summary and ask items (so procurement has a single page to act on):

1) What we agreed:
- Term acceleration: contract effective date moved to 2026-07-01 via one-page addendum. New renewal end date aligns with original schedule (keeps annual cadence).
- Interim capacity top-up: +120k tokens/day between 2026-07-15 and 2026-09-30 on a reserved burst pool.
- Latency SLO: 99th %-ile target < 450ms for model-rw-2b with median seq 120; measurement method: Redwood's agent-side metrics with traces sampled at request-id level and aligned to the pinned model.
- One-time orchestration fee: $6,500 (covers reserved burst provisioning, on-call runbook during launch).
- Daily reserved rate for the top-up window: $1,250/day (prorated; total estimated uplift $78,750).

2) Action items:
- Lauren: circulate the finalized one-page addendum + SLO appendix for signature (Draft attached: Airglow_Term_Amendment_draft.pdf).
- Airglow procurement: confirm acceptance of the daily rate and one-time fee so we can generate a DocuSign envelope.
- Marcus: provide the final orchestration playbook and on-call schedule (will attach to the SLO appendix).

If procurement confirms by EOD Tuesday we can have the DocuSign ready and the reserved burst pool scheduled for provisioning on 2026-07-10.

Thanks — I CC'd Marissa to coordinate the billing terms and invoice timing.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Attachments: Airglow_Term_Amendment_draft.pdf, SLO_latency_matrix.xlsx
